jobs.name: Road Trip Highway
jobs.prompt: 16-bit pixel art, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Vertical story format. Game title 'DOG TRAVEL' in bold pixel font at top with lime #baf122 glow. Subtitle 'by Hack Your Way' below. Golden retriever and cream-white border collie heads sticking out of vintage camper van window, ears flapping, tongues out, pure joy. Van driving ON the road, proper highway with lane markings visible. Long straight road stretching to horizon through desert landscape. Mountains in far distance. Golden hour sunset sky. Wind motion lines. Color palette: lime #baf122, red #ff3131 van, purple #5e17eb sky. 9:16 vertical.
